compute_mean_of_samples: compute the mean of MCMC query samples across chains and samples dimensions
compute_std_of_samples: compute the standard deviation of MCMC query samples across chains and samples dimensions
compute_confidence_interval: compute the 2.5, 50, and 97.5 percentile confidence interval for MCMC query samples
compute_r_hat: compute the potential scale reduction factor R-hat diagnostic for MCMC chain convergence
compute_effective_sample_size: compute the effective sample size diagnostic for MCMC chains using FFT-based autocorrelation
